evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館之西為含碧堂五楹堂後為林虚桂静左為古香齋其東楹有閣為抑齋林虚桂静東稍南為墨池雲後有殿為隨安室（圓明園冊）臣等謹按含碧堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 長春仙館: the five-bay 含碧堂, with 林虚桂静, 古香齋, 抑齋 in its east bay, 墨池雲, and 隨安室 at the rear.

evidence.title: 林虚桂静: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.172 item (1), under 林虚桂静
evidence.excerpt_zh: 春林发育含生意，桂树宜秋漫品题。自是月中常茂密，广寒有路玉绳低。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 林虚桂静, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 林虚桂静: 嘉庆二年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二年 (1797), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.172 item (2), under 林虚桂静
evidence.excerpt_zh: 灿灿玉镜辉，皎皎广寒阙。坐对觉生凉，清光逼毛发。住世偶遇缘，万古一轮月。摩荡益晶莹，与日互出没。晦朔弦朢分，旋转无休歇。丽天瞻夜明，秉阴象发越。久玩漏已深，素彩回丛樾。桂华渐销沈，恐致吴刚掘。只影照虚帷，仰空频咄咄。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 林虚桂静, 1797, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 林虚桂静: 嘉庆十年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十年 (1805), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.172 item (3), under 林虚桂静
evidence.excerpt_zh:
春园花事畅东皇，玉树
亭亭袅淡妆。素萼纷敷摇雪影，银葩层叠逗清香。临风散馥烟笼艳，入夜含辉月有光。梅韵兰心同雅致，坚待洁白傲群芳。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 林虚桂静, 1805, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 林虚桂静
evidence.locator: v2 p.109, under 长春仙馆; source ref 4-175
evidence.excerpt_zh: 霜点寒林叶半黄，虚笼云影逗曦光。团圞金粟桂飘馥，攒族粉针菊缀芳。静体化机相代谢，潜修本性慎行藏。居安弥谨戒盈满，贞固庶几衍泽长。
evidence.summary: Poem 林虚桂静 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1809, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 戏题林虚桂静
evidence.locator: v2 p.82, under 长春仙馆; source ref 1-207
evidence.excerpt_zh: 天上传根月殿，禁林涵育浓醇。曾种广寒不老，移来仙馆长春。
evidence.summary: Poem 戏题林虚桂静 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 林虚桂静
evidence.locator: from p.172, under 长春仙馆
evidence.summary: 林虚桂静: 3 dated items, 1796-1805, of which 3 poems (Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1796, last dated 1805.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
